scene: Inside the dry shelter, colorful tea stalls steam quietly beside wooden benches.
picture: A flat side view inside a dry wooden shelter. On the far left, a tea stall holds a steaming kettle. The player stands left of centre in her yellow coat and green boots, holding her red umbrella. In the centre hangs a bulletin board. On the far right, an open wooden doorway leads outside.
shown: a steaming ceramic kettle sitting on a small wooden counter on the left
a cork board pinned with fluttering notes in the centre
an arched wooden doorway standing open on the far right
